output.reason: Evidence para 261(1) states that for all floating rate loans (granted for purposes other than business to individuals, with or without co-obligant(s)) a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges, and applies to loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026. The case matches: floating rate, non-business purpose, individual borrower, sanctioned on/after 2026-01-01. Therefore, there is no basis for a pre-payment penalty rate for this case.
